species: LC-MS/MS spectrometry analysis identified 721 proteins secreted by E. nipponicum with predominantly immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory functions (peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase, homolog to SmKK7, tetraspanin) and ability to digest host macromolecules (cathepsins B, D, L1).
sample_source: In our study, we conducted a gel-free proteomic analysis of excreted–secretory proteins (ESP), otherwise known as secretome of adult E. nipponicum, which identified 721 proteins with at least two unique peptides (Additional file 7: Table S7).
